records.name: Elastic Slingshot
records.description: Zac attaches his arms to the ground and stretches back, launching himself forward.

description.value: Zac attaches his arms to the ground and stretches back, launching himself forward.

tooltip.value: Begin Charging: Zac pulls himself taut, charging up a dash over {{ channeltime }} seconds. Release: Zac launches himself and Knocks Up enemies where he lands for up to {{ maxstun }} second (based on charge time), dealing them {{ damage }} magic damage . Zac spawns an extra chunk of Goo for each enemy champion hit.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

records.name: Stretching Strikes
records.description: Zac stretches an arm, grabbing an enemy. Attacking a different enemy will cause him to throw both targets towards each other.

description.value: Zac stretches an arm, grabbing an enemy. Attacking a different enemy will cause him to throw both targets towards each other.

tooltip.value: Zac stretches his arm out, attaching it to the first enemy hit to deal {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and briefly Slow them. Zac's next Attack gains increased range and applies the same damage and Slow . If Zac hits a different enemy with this Attack, he Knocks Up both towards each other. If they collide, they and surrounding enemies take {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and are briefly Slowed .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

records.name: Let's Bounce!
records.description: Zac bounces four times, knocking up enemies hit and slowing them.

description.value: Zac bounces four times, knocking up enemies hit and slowing them.

tooltip.value: Zac bounces {{ bounces }} times. The first bounce to hit each enemy Knocks them back and deals {{ damageperbounce }} magic damage . Subsequent bounces deal {{ damagepersubsequentbounce }} magic damage and Slow by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} second. Zac gains up to {{ endingms*100 }}% Move Speed over time and can cast Unstable Matter while bouncing.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

records.name: Unstable Matter
records.description: Zac explodes outward towards nearby enemies, dealing a percentage of their maximum health as magic damage.

description.value: Zac explodes outward towards nearby enemies, dealing a percentage of their maximum health as magic damage.

tooltip.value: Zac's body erupts, dealing {{ basedamage }} + {{ displaypercentdamage }} max Health magic damage to nearby enemies. Absorbing Goo reduces this Ability's Cooldown by 1 second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

records.name: Cell Division
records.description: Each time Zac hits an enemy with an ability, he sheds a chunk of himself that can be reabsorbed to restore Health. Upon taking fatal damage, Zac splits into 4 bloblets that attempt to recombine. If any bloblets remain, he will revive with an amount of Health depending on the Health of the surviving bloblets. Each bloblet has a percentage of Zac's maximum Health, Armor and Magic Resistance. This ability has a 5 minute cooldown.

lore.value: Zac is the product of a toxic spill that ran through a chemtech seam and pooled in an isolated cavern deep in Zaun's Sump. Despite such humble origins, Zac has grown from primordial ooze into a thinking being who dwells in the city's pipes, occasionally emerging to help those who cannot help themselves or to rebuild the broken infrastructure of Zaun.
